Third-party motion assets used by the StealthRDP homepage preview.

1) Lottie Web player
Source: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web
File: build/player/lottie_light.min.js
License: MIT
Copyright (c) 2015 Bodymovin

2) Server Lottie animation
Source: https://github.com/foss42/apidash
File: assets/api_server.json
License: Apache-2.0

The homepage globe is rendered from the already-integrated Joly UI / project
network assets and does not use the previous third-party globe Lottie.

For full license texts and notices, refer to the upstream repositories above.
